name: blog-flow
description: Forkable SEO-first blog starter: Astro on Cloudflare Workers, D1 content DB, R2 media, and an automated research/writing pipeline (Cron -> Workflow -> Workers AI).

scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter site deploy && pnpm --filter pipeline deploy
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply BLOG_DB --local --config apps/pipeline/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to apps/site/.wrangler/state
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply BLOG_DB --remote --config apps/pipeline/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.seed:local: wrangler d1 execute BLOG_DB --local --file db/seed.sql --config apps/pipeline/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to apps/site/.wrangler/state
